name: Borovichi GRS Gas Pipeline Branch (Valday-Borovichi)

values.OtherEnglishNames: Valday-Borovichi Gas Pipeline; Valday-Borovichi-2; Branch to GRS Borovichi 2
values.OtherLanguageAlternativePipelineNames: Отвод к ГРС Боровичи 2; Валдай - Боровичи - 2
values.RouteType: Not mapped (but could be — route or endpoints are known)

researcher_notes: NEW ROW, operating Gazprom Transgaz Sankt-Peterburg branch from the Valday area to GRS Borovichi (Novgorod Oblast). Not in GEM: no Borovichi row in the 20260930 snapshot; P2432 Torzhok-Valdai ends AT Valday (1020 mm trunk) and P2447 Valdai-Pskov-Riga starts at Zimogor'e going west, so the branch (Valday 57.95N 33.28E to Borovichi 58.37N 33.90E, heading NE) is no section of either. Existence/operator: Gazprom procurement notice 10 Jun 2021 (neftegaz.ru) names the object 'Газопровод-отвод к ГРС г. Боровичи' for ООО Газпром трансгаз Санкт-Петербург, with partial liquidation design of section km 65.1-66.7 (L=1.6 km, Du 250). Government Order 166-r of 31 Jan 2017 (government.ru, mirrored on rulaws.ru) calls the existing line 'магистральный газопровод Валдай - Боровичи - 2' (a tie-in at the Valday GRS reconstruction), confirming the string-2 name and operating status. Diameter 530 mm and transmission use: OpenStreetMap way 39422726 (named 'Отвод к ГРС Боровичи 2', operator Gazprom transgaz SPb, 530 mm, pressure tag 54 = 5.4 MPa, matching 166-r design pressure of 5.4 MPa); OSM tier-2 alone, so medium. LENGTH LEFT BLANK DELIBERATELY: the km-post 66.7 is a post on a Gazprom line stationed from the offtake, not a stated pipeline length; it is a sourced lower bound (>=66.7 km, a Du 250 tail section at km 65.1-66.7 vs 530 mm elsewhere), so the >=25 km rule is met comfortably, but no source STATES a length. Unsourced traces agree: OSM 530 mm ways total ~63.9 km, GulfPub 'Valday - Borovichi' geometry 63.8 km (its Length attribute reads 40, unit unstated, ~64 km if miles). Do not enter either as LengthKnown without a source; geometry-derived ~64 km is for the route step. STRINGS: OSM also maps 'Отвод к ГРС Боровичи 1' (273 mm) but only ~0.6 km of it near Valday; the 'Valday-Borovichi' string 1 is not documented as a separate full-length line, so ONE row (string 2). A reviewer may add 'Valday-Borovichi-1' if a source for its extent turns up. Diameter note: the Du 250 in the 2021 notice is for the km 65.1-66.7 section only, not a conflict. Owner entity: entity_lookup finds no 'Gazprom Transgaz Sankt-Peterburg' (only Romanian 'Transgaz'); create as new, Parent Gazprom PJSC. No Start/Construction date found; no cost or capacity found (GulfPub 'Capacity_mmcfd 10000' is a placeholder, ignore). ROUTE: not stored; OSM ODbL coordinate redistribution is Baird's call (route_conventions), GulfPub geometry (OBJECTID_1 16439, 63.8 km, Valday 57.951N 33.279E to Borovichi 58.375N 33.904E) is the §8 candidate source; routes repo not touched. Confidence: existence/operator/status high (2 independent Russian govt/Gazprom docs), diameter medium (OSM only), length unresolved.
